en: Black‑and‑white harbor scene showing many steamships and boats moored along a busy waterfront quay. People walk and work on the cobblestone pier with tram or rail tracks, carts, and early motor vehicles. Industrial cranes and docks line the opposite shore, with low hills in the distance. Text printed along the bottom mentions the view from Skeppsbron and a local publisher in Gothenburg.
